To choose the character to play, latch on
the South (D-Pad Down) button by a soft puff
on the center tube and move the stick to 
pick the character.

To clear South, change mode or activate 
the button again.

To choose weapon, toggle on L2

Use this mode while driving.

Stick Left & Right steers.
Stick Up & Down controls gas/brake.

Use this mode with aircraft while on the ground or during takeoff and landing.

Stick controls rudder and elevator.

Center Hole Puff increases throttle
Center Hole Sip decreases throttle

Use this mode with aircraft while flying.

Stick controls aileron and elevator.

Center Hole Puff increases throttle
Center Hole Sip decreases throttle
